主要内容: On June 8, 2020, Novavax, Inc. (the 'Company') entered into a letter contract with the U.S. Department of Defense Joint Program Executive Office for Chemical, Biological, Radiological and Nuclear Defense (JPEO-CRBND-EB). Under the contract, JPEO-CRBND-EB will provide funding of up to $60.0 million to support the manufacture of NVX-CoV2373, the Company’s vaccine candidate against SARS-CoV-2. The company is authorized to spend up to $22.0 million under the contract, with a definitive cost-reimbursement agreement expected by December 2020, which would cap DoD payments at $60.0 million. If no agreement is reached by the deadline, the DoD may set a reasonable price. The contract also grants the DoD most-favored customer status for five years if NVX-CoV2373 is FDA-approved, restricting the company from offering more favorable terms to other U.S. clients. The full terms are detailed in the company’s Form 10-Q filing for the quarter ended June 30, 2020.
